approvalText: Approve Draft Valuation Batch D with your recommended thresholds.
promotionModeNote: dry_run computes and records states and alerts but never switches a generation. Changing this one value to "live" enables automatic promotion; it is outside the thresholds checksum on purpose, so the flip touches no preregistered number.

classWindow.rule: a class Y candidate is evaluated only at or after 00:00 UTC on nflDraftCompleteOn[Y]; before that, or with no date configured for Y, the state stays FALLBACK_VERIFIED with the reason named

sourceFreshness.contractMaxAgeSource: src.api.league_registry.SCORING_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE_HOURS (SCRAPE_INTERVAL_HOURS x 3); the loader refuses this file if the two differ

thresholdsChecksum.scope: canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators (',',':'), UTF-8) of the 'thresholds' object
